post.title: Nearly 9 in 10 IRS audits of individuals happen by mail
post.ig:
Nearly 9 in 10 IRS audits of individuals happen by mail.

In FY2025, 393,767 of 441,578 individual audits closed (89%) were done by mail.
Audit rates: 0.6% of 2015 returns vs 0.3% of 2021 returns; for 2021 returns, 0.5% with income of $1 to under $25,000 vs 6.6% at $10 million or more.
The IRS starts with a mailed letter, not a text, email or social media message, and never asks for gift cards. A CP2000 mismatch notice wants a reply within 30 days; a notice of deficiency gives 90 days to petition Tax Court.
Look-back: generally 3 years, 6 if more than 25% of income was omitted, no limit for fraud. Disagree? Manager conference, mediation or an independent appeal.

Sources: IRS Data Book 2025 (Tables 3-1, 3-2); IRS.gov audits, CP2000 and scam guidance.
